# Overview {.unnumbered}

The **Assessment Skills Map for GenAI-use** is an open educational resource (OER) developed within the Generative AI Network for Education (GAINEd) of the College of Medical, Veterinary & Life Sciences (MVLS), University of Glasgow.

This interactive framework supports educators in designing, reviewing, and communicating assessments that take account of generative AI’s emerging role in higher education. The resource maps all undergraduate assessments across the life sciences portfolio into common categories and identifies the underpinning disciplinary and transferable skills that these assessments develop.

The initial mapping identified 29 recurring core skills across life sciences programmes and will be updated as needed. For each skill, the map provides exemplar assessment types that measure competency more directly, highlights areas where generative AI may pose risks of inappropriate substitution, where it can be constructively integrated, and where it holds limited relevance.

By centring assessment design on skills rather than tasks, the map promotes programme-wide consistency, provides a shared language for staff and students, and reduces reliance on individual educators’ generative AI fluency. It serves as a practical tool for aligning local assessment design with institutional policy on responsible generative AI use in education.

The resource is open for adaptation and reuse under a Creative Commons Attribution–ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0) licence
